message.content: port the json parser to nom

Plan: replace the handwritten tokenizer in src/parser/lex.rs with nom combinators. Start with `value` (which dispatches on the first char) and work down to literals. Want me to draft the lex.rs rewrite first?
Draft is in src/parser/lex.rs. Notable: switched to `alt((parse_object, parse_array, parse_string, parse_number, parse_bool, parse_null))`. Tests still pass.
